dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Ms. Green, do you really think I can open my own school one day?
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪz ˈɡriːn, duː juː ˈriːli ˈθɪŋk aɪ kən ˈoʊpən maɪ ˈoʊn ˈskuːl ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: With your determination, you're bound to succeed. But it will take time.
dialogue.reading: wɪð jʊr dɪˌtɜːrmɪˈneɪʃən, jʊr ˈbaʊnd tə səkˈsiːd. bʌt ɪt wɪl ˈteɪk ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I hope so. Sometimes I'm not sure I'm capable of running a business.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ˈsoʊ. ˈsʌmtaɪmz aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈʃʊr aɪm ˈkeɪpəbəl əv ˈrʌnɪŋ ə ˈbɪznəs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You've already shown a lot of potential. You started a small business at university, didn't you?
dialogue.reading: juːv ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈʃoʊn ə ˈlɑːt əv pəˈtɛnʃəl. juː ˈstɑːrtɪd ə ˈsmɔːl ˈbɪznəs ət ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti, ˈdɪdənt juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, with my friend Ploy. We sell healthy lunch boxes.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, wɪð maɪ ˈfrɛnd ˈplɔɪ. wiː ˈsɛl ˈhɛlθi ˈlʌntʃ ˌbɑːksɪz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: So you already have some experience. And you're sure to learn even more.
dialogue.reading: soʊ juː ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈhæv sʌm ɪkˈspɪriəns. ənd jʊr ˈʃʊr tə ˈlɜːrn ˈiːvən ˈmɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's kind of you. So what should I do next?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈkaɪnd əv juː. soʊ ˈwʌt ʃʊd aɪ ˈduː ˈnɛkst?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Apply for teaching jobs. With your degree, you're bound to get some interviews.
dialogue.reading: əˈplaɪ fər ˈtiːtʃɪŋ ˌdʒɑːbz. wɪð jʊr dɪˈɡriː, jʊr ˈbaʊnd tə ˈɡɛt sʌm ˈɪntərvjuːz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And if I don't get a job?
dialogue.reading: ənd ɪf aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈɡɛt ə ˈdʒɑːb?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You're bound to hear "no" a few times. That's part of the process.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈbaʊnd tə ˈhɪr ˈnoʊ ə ˈfjuː ˈtaɪmz. ðæts ˈpɑːrt əv ðə ˈprɑːsɛs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. I'm not afraid of hard work.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪm ˈnɑːt əˈfreɪd əv ˈhɑːrd ˈwɜːrk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good. With hard work, you're sure to get there.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. wɪð ˈhɑːrd ˈwɜːrk, jʊr ˈʃʊr tə ˈɡɛt ˈðɛr.
